contract.self_unregister_current_emit: A listener unregistering itself during an active emit still receives the current event because it belongs to the emit snapshot
contract.self_unregister_subsequent_emit: A self-unregistered listener does not participate in subsequent emits
contract.other_listener_delivery: Other registered listeners continue receiving the current and subsequent events
contract.ordering: Current and subsequent deliveries retain deterministic registration order
contract.registry_stability: Self-unregistration does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.idempotent_removal: Removing an already removed listener returns False without mutating the registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after emit and self-unregistration
